explication: JabRef is a cross-platform bibliography and reference-management application. Researchers launch the GUI or CLI, open or import a library, search and organize entries, edit metadata and linked documents, then cite, export, share, or query the collection with AI assistance. The graph preserves documented collecting, organizing, citing, sharing, AI, and language-server capabilities. Several feature links use documented directory-level subsystems because only selected implementation files were sampled; uncertain internal calls are omitted.
